component: Pocket Android launcher/apps and Astro browser workspace
build: Astro build and assembleRom passed. Test suite skipped at the user's request. APK unsigned for the release agent.

build_environment.note: An ignored Gradle init script selects a fresh output directory to avoid an earlier Windows file lock.

web.sign_in_followup: Email/password is shown first. Passkey sign-in is explicit, and passkey creation is labelled separately. Astro build and 390px/1280px account-screen checks passed; the Android APK is unchanged.

focused_verification.environment: Isolated file databases, fictional credentials and synthetic accounts; no production records or paid provider requests
focused_verification.passkey_protocol: Passed: real synthetic P-256 registration/assertions, user verification, origins, challenge replay, expired contexts, duplicate email, multiple passkeys sharing one owner, atomic last-key guard and session revocation
focused_verification.phone_protocol: Passed: claim, approve, redeem and bearer session retain one owner; foreign approvals rejected; codes redeem once; denial and revocation enforced
focused_verification.private_http: Passed: ten unauthenticated private routes return 401, foreign account-start Origin returns 403, null/array restore bodies return 400, owner isolation for sync/search/history/restore/photos
focused_verification.search_and_history: Passed: complete bounded text, ownership, first-checkpoint preservation, editing coalescing, 60-version cap, recent deletion dates, concurrent backfill/sync and rollback when indexing fails
focused_verification.browser: Passed: separate account creation and password sign-in, history restores original text, deleted-note recovery creates a new UID, accent-insensitive Notes/Tasks/Thoughts/Pip matches, newer server matches download before opening and phone-code approval
focused_verification.layout: Account checked at 1280px and 390px; no horizontal overflow
focused_verification.production_database: Connection, additive schema and FTS5 index setup passed; user records were not read or edited
focused_verification.sprites: Contact sheets of all 80 frames inspected; animated playback checked in the browser with the accent tint.
focused_verification.pull_to_refresh: Simulated touch drag in a mobile viewport showed Pip crouching, then synced and hid the indicator.
focused_verification.today_tiles: Browser add/remove/reorder persisted to the preferences document; the server merged a newer layout over an older one and refused unknown preference ids.

full_test_suite.reason: Explicit user instruction; lint also skipped
